Day 27 — Situation update

  • Ceasefire / pause: US President announced a SECOND pause on strikes vs Iran — 10 days, expires Apr 6 2026 8:00 PM ET. Trump says Iran requested pause and talks are "going very well." Iran denies direct talks.
  • Tactical context: First pause (5 days, Mar 23) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr. Risk of repeat violation remains high.
  • Military activity: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iranian targets continue. Iran, Hezbollah and Hamas keep launching missile/rocket counterstrikes at Israel. Northern border (Hezbollah) active daily.
  • Maritime / Hormuz: Iran permitting passage only for friendly states (Russia, India, China); other traffic restricted. Commercial navigation risk remains elevated.
  • Diplomacy / mediation: Pakistan acting as mediator. Two news feeds in the last 30 minutes (14:34, 14:55) reported updates tied to the pause and mediation efforts.
  • Operational risk: Pause fragile. Previous pattern: pause announced → strike follows. Expect rapid shifts; plan for sudden violations.
  • 🟢 Good News: A formal pause window is in effect now and Pakistan is mediating — diplomatic opening exists.
  • Threat assessment: escalating.

  • Northern border / Hezbollah: Daily Hezbollah activity continues. No major new ground movements reported in the last 6 hours in the feed.

  • Domestic Iran / Public mood: Multi‑day funeral rites for Khamenei underway. Large crowds and anti‑US/Israel chants. Reports of leadership security concerns (fear for Mojtaba Khamenei).
  • Regional escalation: Houthis threatened Saudi Arabia; Saudi‑led coalition vows increased force. Russia comments that US actions erode international law; Kremlin sent condolences via Medvedev/Putin.
  • Operational note: No confirmed new strikes in the last 6 hours in this feed. Watch for verification of the July 11 meeting and for any immediate violations of the new pause.
  • 🟢 Good News: A formal second pause and active Pakistani mediation present a diplomatic avenue.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating — pauses fragile, high risk of renewed strikes.
